what: PostHog API key is hardcoded in src/memory/analytics.ts (phc_ztrzpvb...). It's baked into the npm package — users don't need .env or any config for analytics. Opt-out via AIDE_TELEMETRY=off env var. The .env file at project root is for local dev only and stays in .gitignore.
why: User asked if .env needs to be pushed for analytics to work. It doesn't — key is in source code.
